executive_summary: During Fiscal Week 202652, total demand across the Combined Queue (NA DSP Cons CGS) changed by -26.1%. However, Voice (NA Cons DSP) demand reduced by 385 contacts. This indicates that customers chose different contact channels rather than demand reducing. Because the forecast was generated independently for each Forecast Name instead of the CQN, over-forecast and under-forecast errors occurred across individual channels.
business_impact: The over-forecast error resulted in wasted resources and potential loss of customer satisfaction due to over-staffing.

ranked_root_causes.title: Inherited from Higher Level
ranked_root_causes.explanation: The same miss is already visible at Business Org level, so it is not specific to this queue and should be attributed there. This suggests that the issue is not specific to the NA Cons DSP queue but rather a broader problem at the Business Org level.
